notes.title: An unexpected and explosive new Tower Defense!
notes.content:
I have good news for fans of Tower Defense and strategy games ;)
CARNAGE OFFERING TD is at 50% of its programming and is progressing rapidly towards its release.

For now I can only share this wallpaper but more images will come when the project reaches 60% in a few weeks. The Steam page will be available as well as the trailer.

CARNAGE OFFERING TD is coded on Unreal engine 5 so expect a tower defense with very nice graphics and a varied and original level design. More than 40 turrets and more than 30 levels will be available in early access.

Don't forget to follow us on twitter for more news:
https://linktr.ee/futurtechstudio

notes.title: Hints to find in-game cheat codes!
notes.content:
You can now enter 11 cheat codes in the main menu.
But where are the codes? Maybe they are hidden in the levels?

1) The first cheat code is on a clay-based material.
2) The second code is hidden behind a glass prison.
3) The third code is surrounded by wood.
4) You may have to pray to get the 4th code.
5) The 5th code is on a stone pillar and is painted with magic ink that reacts to light.
6) The 6th code is located in the ruins of a vestige of the past.
7) The 7th code is mixed with the other tags of the game and it is gigantic.
8) The 8th code is written behind a gas cylinder.
9) The 9th code hides at the foot of a solid tornado.
10) The replicators have hidden the 10th code on a moving object.
11) The last code is right in front of your eyes but you are not fast enough to see it.

Don't forget to leave a review on steam which will allow you to have your opinions and thus make CARNAGE OFFERING evolve.

Good hunting;)

notes.title: Update number 15 of "CARNAGE OFFERING" has arrived!
notes.content:
The hitbox programming related to weapon damage has been completely revised.
Some players had problems with collisions with enemies.
The smallest configurations were impacted first and I logically solved this problem.
Of course big changes can lead to other problems but the tests are conclusive for the moment on 5 computers with different configurations.
The collisions worked under 20 FPS so the problem should be behind us.
Of course other updates improving this new system will open doors to a higher quality of gameplay but there is still work to do.

The improvements of this update are:

-The damage system and hitbox have been greatly improved
-The AI of some enemies has been improved
-The range of shots has been extended
-The aiming is more accurate but needs more precision especially from a distance
-Weapons balancing has been improved again
-Particle effects have been added when shooting at walls or the ground
-A bug related to healing has been fixed
-Some weapons have a higher rate of fire
-Various bugs fixed

More fixes will come soon ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756180/CARNAGE_OFFERING

notes.title: Update 11: Level 1 improvement
notes.content:
Update 11: Level 1 improvement

After 12 hours of power outage at the studio, CARNAGE OFFERING update 11 has finally found its way to your PCs!
It is with great pleasure that I announce the redesign of the level 1 of our FPS.
Since the release of the game, players have been telling me that the size of this first map was too small.
The zombies tended to gather too quickly and escape was complicated, other players also suffered from a lack of exploration possibilities.
And they were right! And I was also fed up with this map, it had to evolve (other maps will be improved later)
It is certainly not perfect and it will probably never be but if you have other recommendations you know where to find me.

Here are the different improvements and fixes in this update:

-Level Design: Added different paths in level 1 and optimized graphics
-Spaceship level 5: Added extra life bar for the reactors of the replicator ship
-Fixed a language bug on the workbench (Thanks to "paulanocom" who supports Futurtech Studio projects since the beginning)
-Fixed a display bug on the life bar of the final boss in "easy" and "too easy" mode
-Added clues to find the spare parts of the "Peacekeeper". (I simply indicate you the different levels) 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1756180/CARNAGE_OFFERING

notes.title: Our strategy game is on special offer right now!
notes.content:
Take advantage of the moment to work your brain with PAGO FOREST TOWER DEFENSE

The goal of the game is to put the defenses at the right time and place against the enemies. For this, you will need gold! A lot of gold! And courage of course...
The game is composed of 5 acts, 26 missions that each have their own cinematic. Each act ends with a boss.
We will also find a mana bar for the spells delivered by the artifacts (be careful, some powers are only used once per level).
The game is simple to understand but you will have to be strategic to finish it...

Summary of the story: 
Flora, former leader of the Nova army, is back. 
Still alive, Baal the necromancer, contaminates the lands of Pago with his evil powers. 
Flora's mission is to build a great army and recover the artifacts of power to destroy her enemies.

notes.title: Back to the coding of Carnage Offering
notes.content:
Back to the coding of Carnage Offering

Hello everyone :)
I start by thanking the players for their comments on the networks and their reviews on Steam.
The streamers, curators and magazine also for their thirst for discovery and the interest they had for this independent project.
It is essential for the development of the Carnage Offering project, especially since it is a trilogy in preparation.

I just came back from a video game convention and now I'm working on improving the coding of Carnage Offering.
I noticed some bugs while watching the twitch and youtube videos made by you (I didn't miss a single one) that I hope to fix in the next days.

In a second time I intend to improve the immersion of the game by adding animations, music, improve the AI and many other surprises if you are wise ;)

In the meantime continue to make reviews on Steam to inform me of some problems and of course support us.

notes.title: Carnage Offering is 80% complete and I have good news!!!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=gUOXpJrE85c;full][/previewyoutube]
Here is a clip from the second to last level that is in progress.

The alliance's spaceship is facing the replicator robots.
Jake will have to repair Roy's spaceship while facing the machines which will be teleported with each attack of the enemy ship.

There is still something new!!!

We have added a graphic representation of our main character on the top left of the screen on all levels.
This will be one of your health indicators. Jake's head will distort and bleed depending on the damage done.
Blood will also accumulate around your screen as you take damage.
For a more immersive experience, Jake's words will be animated in real time regardless of your general health.

At Futurtech Studio, we try to innovate, to bring up to date old mechanisms that have made the pride of single player FPS and that unfortunately 
have been left a bit abandoned. I'm also talking about the scenario and the dialogues.

There is more and more support from single player fans and for that I thank you.
We will continue to keep you informed about the progress of CARNAGE OFFERING on Twitter.
Feel free to support and encourage our young studio by relaying the posts and adding our game to your Steam wishlist.

Thanks to all:)

notes.title: Happy New Year 2022! I have good news and bad news!
notes.content:
Happy New Year 2022!
I have good news and bad news!

The good news is that Carnage Offering is getting more valuable thanks to a new interface, a more varied bestiary and a more enjoyable gameplay.
Motion capture is added to the dialogue, new bosses will try to stand in your way, and the gameplay is becoming more immersive.
As independent developers, we also try to get some small music studios to work with us to promote them and bring quality to the game.
All this work deserves programming time and now the bad news... The game has been pushed back to March 2022.
It's better to wait a bit and have a quality game than to be disappointed when it's released.

In the meantime, we recommend you to share as much as possible our Steam page. 
We don't have the same financial means as the big development studios and it's hard to be everywhere at once. 
The less time we spend on communication and marketing, the faster the game will be released and with good weapons.
Feel free to add Carnage Offering to your wishlist to be notified of its release day and join us on twitter for more info.

Thanks for your support and see you soon in the dystopian world of CARNAGE OFFERING :)
Take care of yourself and your loved ones.

notes.title: Carnage Offering delayed until January 29, 2022.
notes.content:
More and more of you are supporting the Carnage Offering project and we thank you for that.
We regret to inform you that the launch date of the game has been postponed for the following reasons

- addition of new levels and new game modes
- addition of new enemies in the bestiary
- added new weapons and accessories in the armory
- added Steam achievements and easter eggs
- improved interface
- graphics optimization for non-RTX graphics cards (Nvidia 1000 series)
- improved movement, aiming and control sensitivity
- Various bug fixes
 
We went to a convention a few days ago and got feedback from players on Carnage Offering.
They are very enthusiastic, but as we watched them play we realized that there is still work to be done to make the experience fully satisfying.
We're sorry for the delay but it's worth it.

notes.title: Choose your missions on the screens and Ava will open the wormhole!
notes.content:
In between missions, Jake chats with Ava, the robot assistant who could use a tune-up.
Roy, a long-time friend of Jake's, is happy to hand over the dirty work. Jake comments on the holograms of his future
holograms of his future enemies with disillusioned remarks.

Players have the ability to redo missions at will to increase the money collected from the bounties.
The money will be needed to expand Jake's weapons inventory.

notes.content:
The store hosts weapons such as: Pistol, machine pistol, shotgun, magnum revolver, grenade launcher, assault rifle, double barrel shotgun, rocket launcher, Gatling.
Now there are also accessories such as bulletproof vests and since a few days: exoskeleton leggings.
They allow you to jump higher to escape from enemies, cross rivers of lava or even unlock Easter Eggs hidden in the game's levels.
Futurtech Studio has planned to add a new weapon and an additional accessory soon for the pleasure of players.
